paths.native: Dialog state changes without removing the book.
paths.required: Retained identity survives; input eligibility remains separate.

paths.native: When a dialog was open, clears book directly. Plain non-lectern books are not unconditionally cleared.
paths.required: Revoke only actual slot removal; do not treat every overlay as removal.

paths.native: In-place page/content mutation; lectern close has another direct clear.
